invariants_created: Server MUST send 220 banner before any client command is accepted.
EHLO or HELO MUST be the first client command and MUST precede MAIL FROM.
MAIL FROM MUST precede RCPT TO.
RCPT TO MUST precede DATA.
At least one successful RCPT TO is required before DATA.
RCPT TO can be issued multiple times after a single MAIL FROM to specify multiple recipients.
AUTH MUST follow EHLO (not HELO).
STARTTLS MUST follow EHLO and MUST precede AUTH or MAIL FROM.
RSET returns to the GREETED state (post-EHLO/HELO) without closing the connection, aborting any in-progress mail transaction.
After a completed mail transaction (DATA end), a new MAIL FROM can initiate another transaction without re-greeting.
DATA command must be followed by message content terminated by a line containing only a period (.) character.
NOOP and VRFY can be issued at any point in the session after greeting.
QUIT can be issued from any state to terminate the session.
Issuing commands out of sequence (e.g., RCPT before MAIL, DATA before RCPT) results in a 503 Bad sequence of commands response.
EHLO.hostname: Required. Must be a valid hostname or FQDN identifying the client system. Cannot be empty.
HELO.hostname: Required. Must be a valid hostname or FQDN identifying the client system. Cannot be empty.
AUTH.mechanism: Required. Must be one of: PLAIN, LOGIN, CRAM-MD5. Server must advertise support for the chosen mechanism via EHLO response.
AUTH.credentials: Required (mechanism-dependent). Encoded authentication credentials whose format depends on the mechanism selected.
MAIL.sender: Required. Must be enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., <sender@domain>). Can be <> (null reverse path) for bounce/delivery status notifications. Must be a valid email address format.
RCPT.recipient: Required. Must be enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., <recipient@domain>). Must be a valid email address format. At least one RCPT TO with a 250 response is required before DATA.
VRFY.address: Required. Must be a valid mailbox address to verify.
EXPN.list: Required. Must be a valid mailing list name to expand.

DATA.body: Message content follows the DATA command after receiving 354 response. Must be terminated by a line containing only a single period (.). Lines beginning with a period in the original content must be dot-stuffed (prepend an extra period).
MAIL.sender: Only one MAIL FROM per transaction. A new MAIL FROM requires either completing the current transaction (DATA end) or issuing RSET first.
RCPT.recipient: Can be repeated multiple times per transaction to specify multiple recipients. A 550 response for one recipient does not abort the transaction; other recipients may still be valid.
